race.description: Ladbrokes Tote Win +10% In October Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: DON'T DOUBT MISSY (15) is yet to strike through this campaign but is knocking on the door. Has savaged the line in her last two and if she's close enough when they sprint she will prove mighty tough to stop at 55.5kgs. DUKE OF CAMDEN (6) has mixed his form since resuming and while he missed last time as fav it was narrow and the subsequent form has been red-hot. Draws to get all the favours and gets in well with Youngberry's claim. Bold showing anticipated. ITALIAN DANCER (1) has been ultra-consistent this campaign and finds another suitable contest. Expect Pozman to hunt the front and give them something to catch. HARD EVIDENCE (11) is an interesting runner resuming for the Waller camp. Showed some glimpses in debut AUS prep without winning. Hard to assess off trial but suspect he has some ability. Will pay to keep a close eye on the market.
